title: Multi-Hospital DICOM Sharing Platform
highlights: Real-time DICOM sync across 5+ hospital nodes
35% lower image retrieval latency (O(log n) lookups)
shortDesc: HIPAA-aware healthcare platform for real-time DICOM image sync across hospitals.
fullDesc: A secure, HIPAA-aware healthcare platform enabling real-time DICOM medical image synchronization across 5+ simulated hospital nodes, replacing manual USB/email transfers. Structured metadata indexing cut medical image retrieval latency by 35% and workflow digitization eliminated cross-departmental file transfer bottlenecks.
